name: heat_pump_vitocal_300g
title: Vitocal 300G brine-to-water heat pump (scroll compressor, two plate heat exchangers)
summary: Water-to-water R134a heat pump of the Vaillant Vitocal 300G type: scroll compressor by the Winandy et al. (2002) semi-empirical model or the ARI/Copeland catalogue polynomial, plate evaporator on 30 % ethylene-glycol brine (Thonon + Hsieh) and plate condenser on the water circuit (Thonon + Kuo), both sized from their area with pressure drops, pinch points and hold-up as outputs.
language_features: lookup tables read and written inside procedures
external lookup table by name (ZH38K4E-TFD, missing from the collection)

verification.reference: EES stored solution shipped in the source file (234 variables; key values in the README). Not reproduced by CoolSolve: the native file is blocked and no runnable variant exists. Re-check after C-134: the catalogue table of CSL-0123 (recovered from TM-0560) is a different vintage than the stored run's table (Vs 211.22 vs 82.61 cm3, factor 3-4 in W at the stored point), so it cannot reproduce the stored solution either.
verification.notes: Blocked: documented reference values only (COP 3.0747, W_dot_cp 3004.20 W, Q_dot_cd 9237.10 W, M_dot_r 0.052602 kg/s). No variant: see README 'How to run' (re-check after C-134).

related_external: Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002), Applied Thermal Engineering 22, 107-120 (compressor model cited in the file)
